pre_freeze_disclosure.summary: No new diagnostic was run for this plan. The design uses only the sealed, already-scored study-015 results (Observed on SEEN data): RSX4 0 false, TV_RSX -5.27, coverage proxy RSX4 0.434 vs RG4 0.370; DLFn / RSXn 1 false each on ood4 seed 8140016 mask 0.35; EB 91 false; ood5 RG4 121 false, RG5 0. Held-out v0.14.0 seeds have never been generated.
pre_freeze_disclosure.exact_note: Exact from definitions: (a) RSXL's trajectory equals the SP8 trajectory up to and including the step of RG4's first certificate, so S(RSXL4) = S(RG4) on every case by construction; the headline therefore tests coverage, not time to first certificate. (b) An RG4 certificate requires a non-empty bounded region at 4, so a 'region at 4 is empty' detector cannot block any RG4 certificate at the step it is issued; R_BV measures only after-the-fact detection. (c) DLF margin 2 (min(n_L + 2, 4)) equals RG4 whenever n_L >= 2, so it is reported (R_DLF2) and not offered as a fix.

hypotheses.H_rsxl: Deferred region split RSXL (use the SP8 LU-R choice until the first step at which RG4 on this trajectory has issued a certificate, then the frozen RSX choice) certified by RG4 on its own trajectory (RSXL4) is sound (Exact lemma: RG4 is sound in-family on any trajectory), has S(RSXL4) = S(RG4) on every case (Exact by construction) and issues more certificates than RG4 on the SP8 trajectory (Open; study-015 RSX4 +0.064 coverage but from step 9 on).
hypotheses.H_license: DLF (frozen, margin 1) with the positive and the wrong-family library issues 0 false certificates on fresh seeds (Open after the study-015 DLFn false certificate; replication with a doubled ood4 block).
hypotheses.H_bv: On ood5 targets the bounded region at 4 becomes empty at some step on most cases, after some RG4 false certificates have already been issued (Inferred; reported only).
hypotheses.H_recount: as study-015 (own-trajectory recount equals recorded count; Exact by construction).
